title: Implement a Go word count library
description: Implement three word-count functions in a Go package: CountWords, CountLines, and MostFrequent. All methods have stub panics.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement the three functions in wordcount.go:
1. CountWords(s) — count whitespace-separated words (hint: strings.Fields)
2. CountLines(s) — count newline-separated lines; empty string = 0, trailing newline doesn't add a line
3. MostFrequent(s) — return the most common word, case-insensitive; tie-break by first occurrence; return "" for empty input

Run `go test ./...` to verify all tests pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
